message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads model files from a local directory path with no checksum verification, signature validation, or integrity checks on the loaded files.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool used anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples before or during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The load_model method opens architecture JSON and weight files directly without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before deserializing them.

No detected label distribution validation: The fit() method directly processes text_label_pairs without any class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard Keras/Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress testing anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The evaluation path only performs inference and returns sentiment scores; there is no held-out test set isolation, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code only checks for the presence and non-emptiness of the 'sentence' field but performs no shape, length, type, or content validation before passing input to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (sentiments) are directly cast to float and returned with no NaN guards, probability range checks, or sanity validation on the prediction values.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text input, there is no input filtering, content moderation, or any prompt-injection defense mechanism applied to user-supplied sentences.
